recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if the work group wants new changes to the later EBMonFHIR terminology binding or THO migration decisions; FHIR-28282 itself is already reflected in the current core build.
issue_request: FHIR-28282 was a Published/Persuasive CDS R5 request to rename EvidenceVariable.type to EvidenceVariable.handling, add EvidenceVariable.category, revise variable-handling terminology, add Statistic model code terms, rename StatisticStatisticType to StatisticType, and add Statistic.modelCharacteristic.variable so adjusted analyses can list adjusted variables instead of using modelCharacteristic.value[x].
initial_application: The request was pre-applied by merge commit c7c7e23e42bc614e9429471e7ec54e701fe38423 / PR #971, which changed EvidenceVariable and the Statistic datatype. The historical diff includes StatisticType, modelCharacteristic.variable, variable-handling terminology, adjusted model code entries, and EvidenceVariable.handling/category additions.
additional_context: FHIR-31866 later reincorporated Statistic into Evidence and removed the standalone Statistic datatype. FHIR-51456 and FHIR-52949 changed EvidenceVariable.handling and Evidence.statistic.modelCharacteristic.variable.handling from code/required bindings to CodeableConcept bindings. FHIR-53156 changed EBMonFHIR-owned terminology bindings to example strength and example-named value sets, while FHIR-39632 moved reusable Evidence terminology toward THO. Confluence evidence lists FHIR-28282 as already applied for R5 and contains no conflicting community direction.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active build includes EvidenceVariable and Evidence, and their StructureDefinitions contain EvidenceVariable.handling, EvidenceVariable.category, Evidence.statistic.modelCharacteristic.variable, variableDefinition, handling, valueCategory, valueQuantity, valueRange, and the current StatisticModelCode/StatisticType bindings.

related_jiras.note: Reincorporated Statistic into Evidence and removed the standalone Statistic datatype, explaining why current source checks Evidence.statistic.
Changed EvidenceVariable.handling from code/required to CodeableConcept/extensible and expanded handling concepts.
Made the same handling datatype change for Evidence.statistic.modelCharacteristic.variable.handling.
Changed EBMonFHIR-managed bindings, including Evidence Variable Handling, to example strength and example-named value sets.
Moved several reusable Evidence terminology definitions toward THO, explaining current THO StatisticType and StatisticModelCode references.
Unapplied follow-up about future THO handling for variable-handling-example; not a current source-edit decision for this seed.
